Lately, I've been reading about the [Teapot Dome scandal](https://substack.com/redirect/8c511005-e72b-4964-8fcd-f409f14a3d1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the 1920s. [Albert B. Fall](https://substack.com/redirect/0192b2b1-b1bb-4660-8471-9d803102514e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Warren G. Harding](https://substack.com/redirect/b84c69c8-1e83-42bc-a071-05118aed833c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s Interior Secretary, got caught giving sweetheart deals to oil companies leasing land in central Wyoming.
At the time, [newspapers would say](https://substack.com/redirect/b6aa60e6-ba4b-4278-a031-dd6786080c71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--without a touch of irony--that it was "the greatest scandal in the nation's history."1 Even today, historians [look back on it](https://substack.com/redirect/7b29d272-5d0e-48c5-bb57-fd593662ab06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as "the greatest and most sensational scandal in the history of American politics" prior to Watergate.
If Teapot Dome happened today, I'm not convinced anyone would even notice.
A few weeks ago, _The Wall Street Journal_ wrote an expose about an [Emirati sheikh who secretly bought 49% of a Trump family cryptocurrency venture](https://substack.com/redirect/1c6feb07-d70c-446e-8793-81303b55a71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for $500 million.
What happened next? Two months after that deal, "the [Trump] administration committed to give the tiny Gulf monarchy access to around 500,000 of the most advanced AI chips a year--enough to build one of the world's biggest AI data center clusters."
In a different era, this would've been an administration-defining scandal and Pulitzer Prize-worthy investigative reporting. But in this one, it was out of the news almost immediately.
There are countless stories like this, where Donald Trump and his family abuse their positions of power for personal gain. The scale of the Trump administration's consistent corruption, self-dealing, and bad-faith governance is so vast that we've gotten used to it.
That doesn't mean we should tolerate it.

### Let's set aside all of the other scandals
Donald Trump is a bad, unqualified president for lots of reasons. His policy is terrible; he inspired an insurrection against the country; he's been [accused of rape and sexual assault](https://substack.com/redirect/a9c2351d-0036-4da3-bec0-ab3ac663b7cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by at least 28 women.
Hard though it may be, let's set all of that aside for the moment.
Here's what is relevant to this article:
* [73% of Americans see government corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/c1075007-6a9a-4f0f-9f20-f974db5ccc12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a critical threat to the United States,2 and [only 17% of Americans say that they trust the federal government](https://substack.com/redirect/2c0adc8d-dfdd-4128-9da4-b3c406a154a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* [80% of Americans say corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/decb7505-913a-4b02-9ce0-0b96c80483b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) among members of Congress is a problem, and 72% say corruption among U.S. presidents is a problem.
* "Corruption" is [consistently a top-10 issue](https://substack.com/redirect/1716861b-e70b-4119-b8ec-a8460451ef68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for American voters.

There's a reason that insurgent campaigns--including Donald Trump's, I'll note--work. People don't trust politicians.
But Trump has been the face of one of America's two political parties for more than a decade. He's the quintessence of a political insider. And yet, for reasons I still don't fully understand, brazen corruption scandal after brazen corruption scandal doesn't move the needle.
That doesn't mean we shouldn't chronicle it or call it out. His corruption--in its breadth, scale, consistency, and shamelessness--is breathtaking.
As I see it, **his corruption falls into five main categories** :
1. Old-school shakedowns, backed by the might of the presidency
2. Domestic conflicts of interest and pay-to-play schemes
3. Taking money from foreign governments, Constitutional restrictions be damned
4. Crypto, a new frontier of Trumpian grift
5. Corruption and self-dealing from the rest of his family

This list is hardly exhaustive, both because I don't have the space and because lots of stuff surely isn't being reported. **But** _**each**_**of these stories is as bad as, or worse than, Teapot Dome**. In a different era, any one of these might be disqualifying.3

### Old-school shakedowns, backed by the might of the presidency
* Nine days into Trump's second term, Meta (the parent company of Facebook and Instagram) [paid Trump $25 million to settle a free speech lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/a0f88b76-664d-4fc8-8768-650378d7809b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the wake of the Jan. 6 insurrection.
* Elon Musk did something very similar, [directing Twitter to pay Trump $10 million to settle a lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/a7304066-e2ec-48ba-b90b-218c4303cc39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a few weeks into the second term.
* Alphabet, the parent company of YouTube, [paid Trump $24.5 million](https://substack.com/redirect/b0cc0c82-9fd1-456f-af06-2790039b7388?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to settle the same basic lawsuit.
* Paramount [paid Donald Trump $16 million](https://substack.com/redirect/304ea7ac-36e1-4355-b860-b131dceff9cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (sound familiar?) to settle a lawsuit against _60 Minutes_ coverage that he didn't like.

All of these lawsuits were frivolous. Each of these companies paid Trump directly to curry favor, or at least to avoid his ire.
Since then, white-shoe law firms across the country--[Paul Weiss, Kirkland & Ellis, Simpson Thacher, Skadden, and others](https://substack.com/redirect/535ec964-100b-43a7-8c93-f33407e9c214?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--paid tens of millions in settlements and pro bono legal work for Trump-aligned causes after the president issued executive orders designed to hamstring those firms.
And these shakedowns don't even include the [extortion of Harvard](https://substack.com/redirect/ae77d59e-e7cb-4c33-b773-a8f4ce92a826?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Columbia](https://substack.com/redirect/548e6266-b69d-4936-90b2-9a2fbdf595a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Brown](https://substack.com/redirect/4d276a65-df20-4607-a925-0b095a891236?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and other schools--as insane as those demands are, at least the money isn't going to Trump directly.
### Domestic conflicts of interest and pay-to-play schemes
* Trump uses the presidency to [sell Trump-branded merchandise](https://substack.com/redirect/3b1bb153-262c-4e8c-99a2-cdaf9589698a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that lines his pockets: everything from [shoes](https://substack.com/redirect/bfef641d-5399-47af-add7-98c63ddccee4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [guitars](https://substack.com/redirect/fe0ac31e-dbad-4307-b1c2-afcc2a2145f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [hats](https://substack.com/redirect/da47439e-713f-45ae-8b32-2209f5b65770?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [Bibles](https://substack.com/redirect/e1024b1f-880c-4e50-a9d3-404d617842f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Both [during his campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/cb598596-2859-449d-afd7-82cc1b7f259e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [since his second inauguration](https://substack.com/redirect/b672372a-e071-4430-8e92-457b1891962f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Republican-aligned groups are hosting events at Trump-owned properties that move campaign cash to Trump and his family businesses.
* [Matthew Moroun](https://substack.com/redirect/d1f345e7-232e-4c1c-b803-5f9c89b48222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the owner of the [Ambassador Bridge](https://substack.com/redirect/02ddce17-ffbe-4eeb-9d35-45385e2b4178?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that connects Detroit and Canada, gave $1 million to MAGA Inc.4 in January. Very shortly thereafter, [Trump threatened to shut down development of a competitive bridge](https://substack.com/redirect/0b58e6cb-be8b-4e6e-8001-6e89ad8cd95d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that would damage Moroun's business interests.
* The president [charges $5 million for a one-on-one meeting](https://substack.com/redirect/ee85df49-a3ee-49d6-b887-27b565fe0288?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with no documentation for where that money is going. This [isn't a one-off thing](https://substack.com/redirect/3f6f63dd-a186-45d8-b9ba-e754ba881ce9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* The presidential pardon process is often a shady business.5 But Trump takes the [quid pro quo of pardons to a new level](https://substack.com/redirect/6fd6daec-e61a-4196-a9e8-47dc210d28df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), handing out [pardons to donors](https://substack.com/redirect/0e7d7e38-f7dd-4bfd-84d8-d787ef1ba7e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and turning [million-dollar lobbying for pardons](https://substack.com/redirect/376cacd1-0b9c-4237-8b55-8ca98419ddd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into a cottage industry.

### Taking money from foreign governments, Constitutional restrictions be damned
Here's your reminder that the [Emoluments Clause](https://substack.com/redirect/5aaeb1c7-e492-4091-9d95-b70b7b5d4329?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is part of the U.S. Constitution:
> No Title of Nobility shall be granted by the United States: And no Person holding any Office of Profit or Trust under them, shall, without the Consent of the Congress, accept of any present, Emolument, Office, or Title, of any kind whatever, from any King, Prince, or foreign State.
This was long understood to mean that officers of the U.S.--including, obviously, the president--could not accept payment from foreign nations.
I guess we've entirely given up enforcing that, but Trump takes this to new lows:
* Trump accepted a [$400 million jet from the Qataris](https://substack.com/redirect/211901de-9c0f-4a3b-aca4-e6db23d6801a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which will serve as Air Force One during his presidency and become [part of Trump's presidential library afterward](https://substack.com/redirect/ee30c794-bfde-496d-976c-d41a034f590e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--which would allow him to use it for [personal, post-presidency travel](https://substack.com/redirect/1abf6d0b-3289-4971-8b75-cd54179cc020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Trump's business is opening a [$1.5 billion golf club](https://substack.com/redirect/960c5b4e-4c04-4127-8c98-25b8720e261e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and is building a [$1 billion tower](https://substack.com/redirect/cef0eb46-e94d-4670-816f-3fe2e3088305?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Vietnam while Vietnam negotiated tariffs with the U.S. These projects got [fast-tracked through all sorts of Vietnamese regulatory reviews](https://substack.com/redirect/1034c2e9-fb04-4455-a7c2-4cbc2dd903de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and sure enough, the [U.S. lowered its tariffs against Vietnam](https://substack.com/redirect/91d79b4c-f2fd-4935-8ce9-fdb819199141?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) not long thereafter.
* [LIV Golf](https://substack.com/redirect/5fd46f7f-3f0d-48d3-b030-1f2a2a6d6f19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the rival golf league to the PGA, is owned by the Saudi government and [continues to host events at Trump golf courses](https://substack.com/redirect/c3b18c63-3be5-4152-87ba-a5f4aa1adbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) around the U.S.6 [Yasir Al-Rumayyan](https://substack.com/redirect/a56b9d42-7e2d-46e4-81ef-c1c841d03370?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), governor of the [Saudi sovereign wealth fund](https://substack.com/redirect/95e59957-01f4-4958-9071-1e3162b5d32c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and ally of [Mohammed bin Salman](https://substack.com/redirect/13c98ead-77f8-4cb0-835a-983b8a7da2a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), funds LIV. And given that his job is to advance Saudi interests, he knows exactly what he's doing when [he wears MAGA hats to LIV tournaments](https://substack.com/redirect/d1ddc8c2-268e-4bb8-a788-4756bc62f75a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).7

There's a _lot_ more that could be included here, but I'm covering that in the "Crypto" and "Family" sections below.
### Crypto, a new frontier of Trumpian grift
As I suspect you can tell, and as [I've](https://substack.com/redirect/c0865ae4-a288-4eb9-885d-bc5677b75583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [written](https://substack.com/redirect/1a625345-6554-4ee3-9a88-356a259f743a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [before](https://substack.com/redirect/b77b563e-5768-4ab3-b963-6939f7d73d86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I'm a crypto skeptic. But if you're a believer in Bitcoin or Ethereum and its underlying economic value, that's fine.
But you know what doesn't even _pretend_ to have any value? [$TRUMP](https://substack.com/redirect/f85ea1f0-f8c8-453e-bc4e-d4a83165c895?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [$MELANIA](https://substack.com/redirect/c5ef1430-b8d6-4b5d-b778-ff1d9093b7a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which are explicitly [meme coins](https://substack.com/redirect/5b066fb4-51a3-4681-84a1-aa2359406170?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)! It's basically just gambling where the Trump family gets to take a cut, and it's no surprise the two coins [have lost almost all of their value](https://substack.com/redirect/bb1a3b5e-bb08-4ad4-94d4-ea83643aa188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Another term I'd use to describe meme coins? A [pump and dump](https://substack.com/redirect/05421598-8ff2-419f-8077-bdfaf2e128f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He's fleecing the American people who go in on his so-called investments. It's netted Trump--at least--[$100 million](https://substack.com/redirect/62756fe6-ae41-4c0a-b7bd-b63ac7d05044?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But it's not the only crypto grift he has going:
* The news at the top of this article: an Emirati royal [bought a major stake in Trump's crypto company](https://substack.com/redirect/1c6feb07-d70c-446e-8793-81303b55a71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and got a sweetheart deal on high-end chips for AI processing.

* The crypto industry--to its credit, I guess--was savvy in how they approached Trump: namely, they knew that giving him a bunch of money would buy his loyalty. The crypto industry has become [a reliable pool of donors](https://substack.com/redirect/13c770f7-7eac-48b4-bf66-4f7c42aa4c00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and sure enough, he has [gone from saying that crypto was a "scam"](https://substack.com/redirect/13141b99-4180-41b2-84ad-372cf88289e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to going all-in on it.
* Justin Sun, a crypto investor, put $75 million into Trump-owned businesses. Almost immediately thereafter, [the administration dropped its civil fraud case](https://substack.com/redirect/42f90260-4003-4aba-94d5-0d784c998070?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against him.
* After [Binance](https://substack.com/redirect/74489b0d-3d9a-4ff2-856c-283a335082f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) worked closely to support Trump-owned [World Liberty Financial](https://substack.com/redirect/8997e739-5a4f-46bd-8593-e93d94f66aa1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Binance founder and convicted criminal [Changpeng Zhao](https://substack.com/redirect/bc83c22a-1ea3-41fd-b876-a77af95d663d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) got a pardon.
* [Crypto.com put about $1 billion into Trump's social media company](https://substack.com/redirect/92cd775c-07e5-421f-af59-18c973da2365?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a company whose [revenues are all of $3.7 ](https://substack.com/redirect/ce0c6f83-9cbc-467d-a337-d2016cc39dde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[million](https://substack.com/redirect/ce0c6f83-9cbc-467d-a337-d2016cc39dde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. (As in, $0.0037 billion.) A terrible business decision; a great way to curry favor from a president for sale.

### Corruption and self-dealing from the rest of his family
You could almost have a section on every kid and every son-in-law.
* Most famously: [Amazon paid $40 million for ](https://substack.com/redirect/d7ec97da-c4a3-4ea1-b291-7009dcd75a2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Melania](https://substack.com/redirect/d7ec97da-c4a3-4ea1-b291-7009dcd75a2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , a shocking amount of money for a documentary. It went on to lose tens of millions, but that's [not why Jeff Bezos spent all of that money](https://substack.com/redirect/48f32d2e-c1bc-4a6c-85f8-eca89ffad9d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* 19-year-old Barron Trump has been mentioned as a [possible board member for TikTok](https://substack.com/redirect/0042f1d4-970d-43b6-a493-cc758075b873?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Set aside that he's entirely unqualified, there's no one even close to that young who's an S&P 500 board member.8
* Jared Kushner is up to something so bad that [he's the subject of a whistleblower complaint](https://substack.com/redirect/29659e23-2c4a-4658-a56a-3cb73713ebf4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The details have been withheld, but what we do know is that he's taking billions from different Gulf states, including the [Qatari sovereign wealth fund](https://substack.com/redirect/e38347dc-aec4-4fbc-b1d4-9f7906040894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, America's [princelings](https://substack.com/redirect/4fd974f3-b3e7-4aa6-ab46-2628b05cd881?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), trade on their family name and power extensively: they're [capitalizing on their dad's crypto grift](https://substack.com/redirect/df5cfc7a-5fd7-4a1c-aa62-d4422e71557c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [they're getting involved in public companies](https://substack.com/redirect/9b2ad054-6fa6-4593-9d96-820199cfb977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in what basically amounts to pump and dumps, they're [using their golf club companies to take stakes in defense technology companies](https://substack.com/redirect/2e779435-39a7-4c17-a3a5-8a3fa9ad6cc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)9 that work with the government, and that's just the tip of the iceberg.
* Donald Trump Jr. is a [strategic advisor for Kalshi](https://substack.com/redirect/30c07f75-b069-4bdc-a329-8100cc77a862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and an [investor in Polymarket](https://substack.com/redirect/ed9a0181-fb89-4670-a92a-b1b8f33f5856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Those two are rival prediction markets and that's a crazy conflict of interest in and of itself. But Kalshi and Polymarket keep him around because they're completely [unregulated sports gambling platforms](https://substack.com/redirect/cf0054dc-e40f-4e86-b452-134fc90e9c43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and now that he's involved, the federal government has [shockingly little interest in regulating them](https://substack.com/redirect/0f35b1d4-0547-4d48-9068-7221da584091?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Even Tiffany Trump's husband, [Michael Boulos](https://substack.com/redirect/735d9813-704e-4635-b0cd-53f6c564842d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is getting in on the action, [forging ties with different Saudi businessmen](https://substack.com/redirect/bd25174a-7be2-486a-9c01-21836b4a97b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since marrying into the family.

To get ahead of any whataboutism: yes, Hunter Biden traded on his dad's name too. He's not a good dude. But there's no parallel here; this is all so much more extensive than anything Hunter Biden even did.
### Trump won't ever face consequences
There are people in my orbit who think--or hope, maybe--that one day, Trump will face consequences for the brazen corruption.
He won't. Weaseling his way out of legal trouble appears to be a superpower. But that doesn't mean we should stop calling out the corruption as we see it.10
One of my all-time favorite articles is a [1999 ](https://substack.com/redirect/c20b9096-0275-4f90-adeb-86c4581021e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/c20b9096-0275-4f90-adeb-86c4581021e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ piece by Paul Simon about Joe DiMaggio](https://substack.com/redirect/c20b9096-0275-4f90-adeb-86c4581021e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who had died the day before. The two were bound by the famous lyrics of "[Mrs. Robinson](https://substack.com/redirect/fb10e306-fecd-48fd-ae78-681f1bd5ce0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."11
Simon, in his telling, meant DiMaggio's reference in "Mrs. Robinson" as a metaphor: "I thought of him as an American hero and that genuine heroes were in short supply." Writing the article in the throes of the [Clinton impeachment trial](https://substack.com/redirect/696cb5f5-3b97-4b7a-b5d3-1d22bfcabdba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he longs for DiMaggio's kind of heroism:
> In these days of Presidential transgressions and apologies and prime-time interviews about private sexual matters, we grieve for Joe DiMaggio and mourn the loss of his grace and dignity, his fierce sense of privacy, his fidelity to the memory of his wife and the power of his silence.
Think about how far we've sunk since then--if _only_ the scandals were run-of-the-mill Oval Office affairs. But the sentiment is right: we should aspire to a greater dignity and respect, now more than ever.
We have a tendency to [look back through history with rose-colored glasses](https://substack.com/redirect/f81f7a82-c925-479e-a74a-2476771d0d78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); our leaders have never been perfect. But we've come to tolerate what should be intolerable.

1
I link to just one newspaper here, the Mooresville Enterprise of [Mooresville, North Carolina](https://substack.com/redirect/e7b03d4d-beae-46fc-9755-bd8f5b57ed56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), because a) it's a clean quote, and b) it's been digitized, which isn't the case for a lot of newspapers of that era. But quotes like "the greatest scandal in American history" or "greatest scandal since [some other long-forgotten scandal]" come up all the time in contemporaneous coverage.
2
In a different poll, 85% of Americans say that [corruption is a problem](https://substack.com/redirect/375300eb-3811-4de1-93f7-c24e86e42382?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the U.S. The issue with this specific poll question is that "corruption" in this context is a bit of a Rorschach test: corruption could mean anything from politicians taking bribes to the media being in someone's pocket to fraud within government programs. So I don't think it's the most helpful way of looking at this.
3
In a different era, they might also become scandals that get their own -gate name: Metagate, Binancegate, LIVgate, etc. But alas, not in the moment we're living in.
4
Could be obvious from its name, but [MAGA Inc. is a Trump-aligned super PAC](https://substack.com/redirect/38b8bf51-e521-4df5-a924-59ff8c6929c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
5
Examples: [Roger Clinton](https://substack.com/redirect/c818d03b-2706-44bc-8039-84539d6695c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was pardoned by his half-brother, and [Hunter Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/d2edc0f3-042d-4cee-94e4-df1edc06305d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was pardoned by his dad. Both Democratic presidents, both very bad looks. Not for nothing, neither Roger nor Hunter seems like an especially good dude.
6
This season, LIV is hosting events at Trump courses in [Virginia and New Jersey](https://substack.com/redirect/1eac5daa-f8f0-4793-ba3f-f9eef333087b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Last year](https://substack.com/redirect/cb6083bd-b6e6-47ff-a404-881436ffe833?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [the year before](https://substack.com/redirect/1f5c7001-76db-44dc-beca-038369230236?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), they hosted events at his course in Miami.
7
I have zero hard evidence to back this up, but I have a longstanding theory (call it a conspiracy theory if you must) that the Saudi government funds LIV for the sole purpose of currying favor with Donald Trump. They've paid out [hundreds of millions in guaranteed contracts](https://substack.com/redirect/8ea85aca-b6ee-4491-b962-da6bc55e939d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to golfers on top of [another couple hundred million in purses](https://substack.com/redirect/0975152e-85e0-4885-8d37-6213053a7bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) every season without a prayer of ever seeing a return on that investment.
The [league's TV ratings are abysmal](https://substack.com/redirect/2f33576b-1497-480a-b087-2e29ed2fd015?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and they've got almost no cultural cachet. LIV just [lost one of their stars](https://substack.com/redirect/96249a37-190f-4489-b80f-5fb2c477592d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and, because its players get few [Official World Golf Ranking points](https://substack.com/redirect/ff39e0f6-f230-471c-beab-01ba6227474a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it's tough to qualify for majors and so they're losing relevance. (They only started getting points last month.)
So why keep spending all of this money? Well, it's a very easy way for the Saudis to buy loyalty from Trump--see the [Yasir Al-Rumayyan photo I mention above](https://substack.com/redirect/d1ddc8c2-268e-4bb8-a788-4756bc62f75a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--without making it a straight-up bribe. (Emoluments Clause be damned.) That's clearly worth well more than a few measly hundred million for the Kingdom.
I can't think of a good business (or golf) reason why it makes sense to keep LIV alive otherwise.
8
Yes, the new TikTok won't be on the S&P 500. (I don't think.) But no director is even close to that young. Best I can tell, the youngest directors of S&P 500 companies are either the [co-founders of DoorDash](https://substack.com/redirect/0a541a9e-fdca-4c00-b739-63898b209ffe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or Olivia Tyson, [on the board of Tyson Foods](https://substack.com/redirect/112d2043-1e47-4682-9d78-490cbd860247?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), her family business.
[Only 5% of S&P 500 directors](https://substack.com/redirect/9238fda9-e9d1-49f4-b3f3-e448fcdfb42b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are under _50 years old_. That's maybe a bad thing, but it shows that Barron Trump would be an incredibly crazy outlier.
9
Think about that sentence for a moment. Here are the [first two paragraphs from a ](https://substack.com/redirect/2e779435-39a7-4c17-a3a5-8a3fa9ad6cc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Reuters](https://substack.com/redirect/2e779435-39a7-4c17-a3a5-8a3fa9ad6cc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ article](https://substack.com/redirect/2e779435-39a7-4c17-a3a5-8a3fa9ad6cc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Aureus Greenway, a golf club company backed by the sons of U.S. President Donald Trump, said on Monday it would merge with Powerus in a deal designed to take the drone technology company public.
> The transaction is the latest in Eric and Donald Trump Jr.'s growing investments in the drone sector, following last month's [$1.5 billion tie-up](https://substack.com/redirect/efa3729b-498d-49b5-8c4a-ee6ada691530?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between Israeli drone maker XTEND and Florida-based JFB Construction.
10
Corruption is, of course, nothing new. A fun, local, low-stakes version of that: the St. Louis city treasurer is in some hot water for [giving his girlfriend a hangtag](https://substack.com/redirect/6483ba65-c9cb-4cb0-833a-936d546b7e81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that gets her out of parking tickets. Not good. But also, why can't _this_ be the corruption we're facing as a country?
11

### How Idaho's Department of Health and Welfare ignored our concerns and kept running an "illegal" program
| | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Mar 11
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2114823&post_id=190621359&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkwNjIxMzU5LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc3MzI0NDgxMywiZXhwIjoxNzc1ODM2ODEzLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjExNDgyMyIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.uqrYTfThcK-5ig4wpSlgjlmzM42X60_Kx2OJZwPF7oM&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/brianlenney/p/we-asked-for-fraud-prevention-they?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)

Last December, Representative Josh Tanner and I sent Director Juliet Charron at the Department of Health and Welfare an urgent letter with one simple request: pause $14 million in childcare grant disbursements until fraud prevention measures were in place:

Because Minnesota had just uncovered one of the largest welfare fraud schemes in U.S. history. Their childcare subsidy program. Hundreds of millions stolen with fake providers billing for fake children. The whole thing was systematic looting under the guise of "helping families."
And Idaho's program was/is structurally identical.
So we asked for temporary suspension of disbursements, a comprehensive fraud prevention plan (e.g. enrollment verification, financial transparency, inspection protocols), review of prior disbursements to identify existing fraud, and a legislative briefing.
**Pretty reasonable when you 're watching Minnesota burn, right?**
Three months later, DHW's response arrived.
Not a briefing. Not a fraud prevention plan - [a bill.](https://substack.com/redirect/31bed80b-80d3-4c31-94c9-48c6ddc8e3a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31bed80b-80d3-4c31-94c9-48c6ddc8e3a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This bill doesn't pause anything, review past disbursements, or address our concerns about enrollment verification and financial transparency.
What it does do though is create a massive new vendor contract for "fraud detection" using AI and machine learning. And it authorizes that same vendor to create 600 new licensed childcare programs.
_**So we asked them to stop the bleeding and they handed us a bill to hire a contractor to build 600 more places to bleed from.**_
But wait... it gets worse.
Buried in Director Charron's March 9th letter to the Joint Finance-Appropriations Committee is a confession that should terrify every taxpayer in Idaho:

According to here, the Idaho Child Care Program has been running... _**illegally.**_
Yes, IDHW has been administering a multimillion-dollar program with no statutory authority to do so.
Charron admits it plainly:_****_
_**" DHW has determined that the authority in code we have historically relied upon for rulemaking is insufficient to sustain any of the ICCP rules."**_
They've been operating on "general rulemaking authority" under a statute that doesn't actually authorize childcare programs. Because the child care subsidy program isn't found anywhere in Title 56 (or any other title in Idaho Code). No authority to promulgate rules.
So how long have they known this?
Charron doesn't say. But she does threaten that if this legislation (or something substantially similar) isn't enacted this session, DHW will have no choice but to eliminate the rules and wind down ICCP by the close of the fiscal year. Potentially earlier.
So wait... you've been running an "illegal" program. You know it's "illegal." _And instead of pausing it immediately, you 're threatening to shut it down unless we pass your vendor-friendly bill?_
That's legislative hostage-taking.
**And Charron 's legal logic creates some really awkward questions.**
For instance, Idaho Code § 56-202 gives the DHW Director authority to _" promulgate, adopt and enforce such rules and such methods of administration as may be necessary or proper to carry out the provisions of title 56, Idaho Code." _
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fdce5551-3f8d-4df0-b6f4-4841a977df02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Charron says this authority is insufficient for ICCP because childcare subsidies aren't specifically mentioned in Title 56.
Okay. Taking her at her word.
But Title 56 is also the welfare code that contains public assistance programs like TANF, food stamps, and even Medicaid. A whole constellation of federal welfare programs that Idaho administers through administrative rules promulgated under that same general authority in § 56-202.
If ICCP rules are illegal because childcare subsidies aren't explicitly enumerated in Title 56, then what about all the other federal welfare programs DHW administers through administrative rules?
_**Are those illegal too?**_
Either § 56-202 gives DHW authority to implement federal welfare programs through administrative rules (in which case ICCP is legal and this whole "we have no authority" argument is manufactured leverage), or it doesn't (in which case DHW has been running multiple illegal programs for years).
Can't have it both ways.
I'm not saying Charron is wrong about the law. _I 'm saying her legal conclusion creates questions about everything else DHW does_. And the timing of this "legal discovery" is mighty convenient, right? We asked them to pause disbursements and prevent fraud. Three months later they suddenly discovered they've been operating "illegally" all along and oh by the way we need you to pass this bill that authorizes everything we're already doing plus $30 million more.
So, let's look at what they're actually asking for in this new childcare bill S1374.
The bill creates a "fraud detection and remediation system" that must be implemented by July 1, 2027 (18 months from now). Meanwhile, the program keeps running. Money keeps flowing. No pause. No review of past fraud. Business as usual until the vendor's AI system goes live.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/708fee27-18ab-4bf7-baa8-5e4df499b622?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Who writes sections like 56-2508 and 56-2509?
_" The system shall assess relative risk using statistical and expert-defined analytical models to support the prioritization of cases." _
That's a sales pitch. I bet the vendor wrote this bill and DHW carried it for them. The bill also prioritizes "child care services managed through vendors" for capacity-building funds. So the vendor gets paid to build the fraud detection system AND gets prioritized for grants to create new childcare programs.
_Real convenient._
Remember what we asked for in December? Enrollment verification. Financial transparency. Inspection protocols.
They're not in this bill.
The bill sets income eligibility at 155% of federal poverty guidelines (56-2504). The legislature originally approved 145%. Then DHW administratively raised it higher without legislative approval and the program went financially underwater. When Alex Adams was IDHW Director, he cut eligibility back to 130% and the program stabilized and costs became predictable.
Now S1374 proposes 155% - higher than what the legislature originally approved and way higher than the 130% that actually works. So in a bill supposedly about fraud prevention, they're expanding eligibility beyond levels that already proved financially unsustainable.
S1374 creates rules about "reasonable suspicion" and "intentional program violations" and gives DHW massive enforcement powers too. But it doesn't require the basic anti-fraud measures that would have prevented Minnesota's disaster in the first place.
Provider attestation isn't verification. And AI risk scoring? That's not inspection.
This bill is bureaucratic theater designed to look like fraud prevention while actually just creating new contracts.
Minnesota's actual problem? They allowed providers to self-report attendance. No verification or spot checks. Just "trust us." So of course fraudsters created fake childcare centers and enrolled fake children. Of course they billed for services they never provided. And billions disappeared because nobody was checking if the kids actually existed.
Idaho's "solution" in S1374?
Provider-reported attendance verified through a fraud detection system that analyzes... provider-reported data.
Yes, the bill requires providers to document "proof of attendance each day with authentication" but that authentication is still coming from the provider.
_**But if providers are lying about attendance in the first place, analyzing their lies won 't catch them.**_
This is building Minnesota in Idaho.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/198c6f45-96b2-4bd3-b32f-bcf7d7f6a1b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Are you ready for 600 new Idaho Learing Centers?_
We're not just talking about fraud in an existing program. We're talking about expanding a program DHW now claims is "illegal." A program even its own administrators admit they have no authority to run.
And the finance commitee (JFAC) just appropriated $30 million in federal funds to expand childcare capacity. Charron's letter complains the intent language is too restrictive. She's upset that JFAC wants to exclude providers who have been investigated for fraud "even if the provider was subsequently cleared." She's upset that "publicly funded entities" might be excluded. Notes that "all ICCP providers receive public funds as a mere fact of being enrolled."
**Wait ... you want us to give you $30 million to expand a program you've been running "illegally?" You want minimal restrictions on who can get that money? And you're threatening to shut the whole thing down if we don't pass your vendor-written bill?**
_How about ... NO._
Instead, what if families raise their own children? Or how about private childcare businesses operate in a competitive market with minimal regulation and zero subsidies?
Because at the end of the day, the government shouldn't be paying for childcare. And creating capacity for 600 NEW daycares (like 1374 does) through subsidies and vendor contracts just builds a fraud machine (any means-tested welfare program has the same problem).
Minnesota didn't fail because they had insufficient fraud detection technology.
_**Minnesota failed because they created a massive pot of money with minimal oversight and incentivized fraudsters to steal it.**_
The fraud was inevitable given the program's structure.
And Idaho is about to make the same mistake (just with AI this time).
Did you know that S1374 includes language about "relative child care" as a priority for capacity-building funds? Know what that is? It's paying someone to watch their own grandchild, niece, nephew, or sibling.
We're going to build 600 new licensed childcare programs and prioritize ones where Aunt Sally gets paid by the state to watch her sister's kids:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e663a76a-9e59-4014-83aa-5c52354d720d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This isn't helping families.
This is subsidizing arrangements that would happen anyway and creating new opportunities for fraud.
Because once you start paying Aunt Sally, you need to verify she's actually providing care. You need to verify the kids actually exist. You need to verify the hours being claimed. You need a fraud detection system. You need five employees to run the fraud detection system. And you need a vendor to build the technology platform.
_Pretty soon you 've spent $30 million in federal funds to create a jobs program for bureaucrats and contractors while Aunt Sally gets $21 an hour to do what she would have done for free._
Also, according to 1374, eligible children must be in the country legally, but there's no such requirement for parents or providers.**** So we'd be paying illegal immigrant providers to watch their own relatives' kids. The bill prioritizes relative care. The bill has no meaningful fraud prevention.
_**This is everything wrong with modern conservatism in one piece of legislation.**_
We talk about fiscal responsibility while appropriating $30 million for a program IDHW claims is "illegal." We talk about fighting fraud while creating new vendor contracts instead of basic verification systems. We talk about family values while subsidizing arrangements that undermine family formation and community bonds.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eb8bd245-79e5-4789-ac03-4438b8a7326a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Real conservatism?
_Government shouldn 't be in the childcare business. Period._
If Idaho families need help affording childcare, the solution is economic growth that raises wages and lowers costs. Or reduce regulations that drive up provider costs. Remove barriers to entry for new small providers.
Welfare programs aren't the answer. Government subsidies to providers just create more problems. And paying some vendor to create 600 licensed facilities?
_That 's the opposite of what we need._
S1374 isn't the answer. ICCP should be wound down properly if it's actually illegal. And expanding childcare capacity through government spending? That's how you get Minnesota.
**Don 't build Minnesota in Idaho.**
Charron says if we don't pass this bill, DHW will wind down the ICCP program?
_Fine. Do it._
If you genuinely believe you've been running it illegally anyway, shut it down properly. Review the disbursements for fraud. Prosecute anyone who stole taxpayer dollars. Come back with a clean bill that just provides statutory authority for whatever minimal program the legislature decides to maintain.
But don't threaten us with program shutdown while simultaneously demanding we pass an expansion bill written by vendors.
That's what we asked for in December.
That's what we're still asking for today.

I’m proud to be fighting for Oregonians like you every day.

| **Election Updates** Democrats have [flipped 26 state legislative seats](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=d157392463&e=d6c5c7d7ec) since Donald Trump took office, while Republicans have flipped zero. Democrats have now overperformed or won in 251 out of 281 key elections since Trump was inaugurated.

**Recent Democratic victories:**
* _Texas_ : Democratic early voting surpasses Republican for first time in 20+ years, with 1.33 million Democrats voting early, a [126% ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=c5c1d5c61e&e=d6c5c7d7ec)rise from 2024 and 35% from 2020.
* _North Carolina_ : Democrats saw a huge turnout, with over 700,000 ballots in the Democratic primary, [surpassing](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=287aaa58b7&e=d6c5c7d7ec) 2024 and 2022 levels. Democratic turnout was nearly 50% higher than Republican turnout.
* _Arkansas_ : Alex Holladay won the Arkansas House District 70 election by nearly [15 points](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=1e4fbd5e66&e=d6c5c7d7ec), a seat that Democrats have not held for over a decade.
* _Maine_ : [Scott Harriman](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8f8d4b915f&e=d6c5c7d7ec) defeated his extreme MAGA opponent in the House District 94 special election, ensuring Democrats retain their majority in the House.
* _Louisiana_ : [Chasity Verret Martinez](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=b4f2aecc68&e=d6c5c7d7ec) just clinched a key victory to defend a Democratic seat in a district that Trump carried by 13 points.
* _New York_ : [Erik Bottcher](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8a305755e9&e=d6c5c7d7ec) won New York Senate District 47 with 91.7% of the vote. Democrats increased our vote share by nearly 20 percentage points this year.
* _Pennsylvania_ : Ana Tiburcio and Jenniger Mazzocco [won](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=5d90079d64&e=d6c5c7d7ec) special elections to represent Pennsylvania House Districts 22 in Lehigh County and 42 in Allegheny County, respectively.

---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| **DNC Launches Largest-Ever In-Person Nationwide Trainings for Next Generation of Campaign Staff Ahead of the 2026 Midterms**

The DNC**[launched](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=16b4fec08b&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **its NextWave Regional Bootcamp training program, the DNC’s largest-ever in-person campaign staff training program, to ensure Democrats have the best talent prepared to run and win campaigns in 2026 and beyond. The program will train hundreds of staff in the coming months on a variety of core campaign skills, including fundraising, communications, voter registration, organizing, and more.

|

| We are excited to share that the DNC will be launching our first of four National Voter Registration Week of Action in 2026 at the end of March. Through this initiative, our goal is to activate supporters nationwide, as well as state parties and College Democratic chapters, to register more than 6,000 new Democrats in the first Week of Action of the year.

**Here’s what you need to know:**
* The Week of Action will take place from Friday, March 27th, to Friday, April 3rd.
* We’re encouraging supporters and partners to host in-person voter registration drives across the country during the Week of Action.

**How we’ll support you: **
* _Merchandise_ : the DNC will provide VRWOA merchandise to all participants who register their drive by Friday, March 13th.
* _Training & Toolkits:_ The DNC will provide toolkits and virtual trainings to prepare all participants to host successful registration drives. Register for a Training in March: [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=d436277491&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

**Next steps: **
* Sign Up to Host a Drive: Register your drive using the official form and include the mailing address where we should send merchandise.
* [Sign up to Host a VR Drive](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=63ab213556&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
* _Deadline_ : March 13th to receive merchandise ahead of the WOA

Callais so community members could learn what the ruling could mean for equal representation, redistricting laws nationwide, and the future of the Voting Rights Act—and what Democrats are doing to fight back.

| **Inaugural DNC AAPI Caucus Lunar New Year Organizing Call**

The DNC and DNC AAPI Caucus hosted their first-ever Lunar New Year Organizing Call to address the Asian American community in celebration of the year of the Fire Horse. The call’s attendees heard from DNC AAPI Caucus Chair Bel Leong-Hong, DNC Executive Director Roger Lau, Cincinnati Mayor Aftab Pureval, and Texas House Minority Leader Gene Wu.
---
|

| **DNC AAPI Caucus and South Asians for America Know Your Rights (KYR) at the Polls Training **

The DNC, DNC AAPI Caucus, and South Asians for America hosted a KYR training for those interested in learning about voting rights at the polls and how the DNC is actively safeguarding elections. DNC Vice Chair Shasti Conrad and Texas House Minority Leader Gene Wu spoke to the broader AAPI community about the importance of knowing their rights during these trying times.

|

| **[Newsweek](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2c0d212dc2&e=d6c5c7d7ec): **Inside DNC Chair Ken Martin’s Plan To Turn Democratic Momentum Into Power

_**Key Point:**_ _“Martin’s job is ensuring the right combination of resources and strategy translates into November victories that actually shift power. And he ascended to his current position by promising to invest in the Democratic state parties to rebuild the Democratic Party’s organizing infrastructure across the country. His pitch: The special election streak isn’t luck or Trump backlash—it’s proof that his strategy works.”_

---
|
---
| **DNC [statement ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=90f03aa1f7&e=d6c5c7d7ec)on Black History Month **

_In observance of the start of Black History Month, DNC Chair Ken Martin and DNC Black Caucus Chair Virgie M. Rollins released the following joint statement: _

“During Black History Month, we reflect on the rich history of Black Americans and their centuries-long struggle to overcome adversity and injustice in our country. We stand on the shoulders of giants — Crispus Attucks, Harriet Tubman, Frederick Douglass, Fannie Lou Hamer, Langston Hughes, Toni Morrison, Thurgood Marshall, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., and so many more — who paved the way for trailblazing leaders like John Lewis, Shirley Chisholm, Barack Obama, and Kamala Harris to follow in their footsteps. Throughout February, we honor their accomplishments and affirm our steadfast belief that Black history is American history. It cannot be erased or whitewashed away by those who seek to turn back the clock.

“Over the past year, Democrats have tirelessly fought back against Donald Trump and his Republican enablers, who seek to dilute the electoral power of Black voters by dismantling key voting rights protections and redrawing electoral maps for political gain. Despite Republicans downplaying — or worse, justifying — the immoral injustices of slavery and Jim Crow, Democrats have fought and will continue to fight for a better future, one where quality health care, affordable housing, and a good education are the birthright of every American. During Black History Month, we recommit ourselves to this fight.”
---
|
# DNC Statement on Women’s History Month
[_In celebration of Women’s History Month, DNC Chair Ken Martin and DNC Women’s Caucus Chair Alicia Andrews released the following statement:_](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8a782398f7&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

“Throughout the month of March, we honor the women who broke barriers and shattered glass ceilings so others could follow. These trailblazers, known and unknown, sacrificed to push our nation forward, advocating for women’s rights, demanding recognition for women of color, and risking violence and arrest as they fought for the right to vote.

“In honor of their legacy, each of us has a responsibility to continue the work to demand equality, justice, and freedom for all women. As Democrats, we will never back down from this fight.

“We will continue our fight to end the gender wage gap; expand the child tax credit; support women-led small businesses and entrepreneurs; restore access to reproductive health, including abortion rights; strengthen the Violence Against Women Act; and so much more. We will directly oppose Republicans who seek to turn back the clock for women and put lives and economic opportunity at risk. And we will always strive to deliver a better future where the fundamental rights and freedoms for women and girls are secured and expanded for generations to come.”

clean_body: | | | Peter, This is a moment that demands organizing. Families are feeling the pressure of rising costs. Our political system is still rigged for billionaires. And the fights ahead — from Congress to our communities — are only getting bigger. We’ll be joined by Illinois State Senator Robert Peters, a Working Families Party–endorsed candidate running for election to the U.S. House to represent Illinois’ 2nd Congressional District. Peters is a longtime movement leader fighting for working people, and his race is part of the broader fight to build power for working families in Congress. We’ll also hear from political activist Linda Sarsour and community organizer Tim Hernandez of Indivisible , who will share their perspectives on this political moment and the organizing it will take to win. Together, we’ll dig into what’s at stake in 2026, how WFP is organizing to build a working families bloc in Congress, and what it will take to put working people in charge. And as always, we’ll leave with clear ways to plug in and take action together. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. 🚨 BREAKING NEWS: We did it.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-shawnharris?refcode=260311em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-shawnharris?refcode=260311em]
Last night, our campaign finished FIRST in a 17-candidate race to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene, and forced a runoff against Donald Trump’s hand-picked Republican.
Let me say that again: A Democrat just earned the most votes in MTG’s district. In a deep-red seat that MAGA thought belonged to them forever.
This is a political earthquake.

Hi friends, I have some good news to share with you this week.

This campaign is picking up steam, making connections and building support across RI. One big way that happens is through endorsements. And I’ll tell you, it’s pretty humbling when people you respect and admire come out and stand behind you!

**This week, I’m incredibly proud to share that several leaders I’ve worked closely with are endorsing my campaign for Lieutenant Governor:** former State Rep Aaron Regunberg, former Ward 2 Councilwoman Helen Anthony, and Councilmen Miguel Sanchez, and Justin Roias.

These are people who know me well. We’ve worked and served together, worked through tough policy battles together, and fought to make government work better for Rhode Islanders together.

They’ve seen how I approach this work — bringing people to the table, standing up against entrenched interests and the status quo, and refusing to accept that government can’t do better for our communities.

**Their support means a lot._But you know who might know me even better? You!_**

You have been part of this journey from the very beginning of my career on the Providence City Council, showing up to events, sharing ideas and feedback, pushing me to be even bolder, reading and commenting on my newsletters, and now believing that the Lieutenant Governor’s office can actually be a force for change. Many of you have worked with me on a board or commission, when I was our “food czar” in the Raimondo administration, or as a climate policy advocate. You know me & you know how much I love this work.

This campaign has never been about politics.

clean_body: | | | Hi friends, I have some good news to share with you this week. This campaign is picking up steam, making connections and building support across RI. One big way that happens is through endorsements. And I’ll tell you, it’s pretty humbling when people you respect and admire come out and stand behind you! This week, I’m incredibly proud to share that several leaders I’ve worked closely with are endorsing my campaign for Lieutenant Governor: former State Rep Aaron Regunberg, former Ward 2 Councilwoman Helen Anthony, and Councilmen Miguel Sanchez, and Justin Roias. These are people who know me well. We’ve worked and served together, worked through tough policy battles together, and fought to make government work better for Rhode Islanders together. They’ve seen how I approach this work — bringing people to the table, standing up against entrenched interests and the status quo, and refusing to accept that government can’t do better for our communities. Their support means a lot.But you know who might know me even better? You! You have been part of this journey from the very beginning of my career on the Providence City Council, showing up to events, sharing ideas and feedback, pushing me to be even bolder, reading and commenting on my newsletters, and now believing that the Lieutenant Governor’s office can actually be a force for change. Many of you have worked with me on a board or commission, when I was our “food czar” in the Raimondo administration, or as a climate policy advocate. You know me & you know how much I love this work. This campaign has never been about politics. It’s about building a team of Rhode Islanders who want a government that fights for them — on energy costs, housing, environmental protection, and a state government that actually works for people. So today I want to ask you something simple:**** **** , you’re telling Rhode Islanders that you believe we can make the Lieutenant Governor’s office a real advocate for the people of this state. Having supporters like you on this team means just as much to me as any endorsement from inside government. So if you’re behind me and my campaign, I’d be honored if you’d add your name to the growing list of folks inside politics and out who believe a better future for all of us is possible. | | Former State Rep Aaron Regunberg Councilwoman Helen Anthony Councilman Miguel Sanchez Councilman Justin Roias | | I’ve got even more good news to share later this week. | | **Friend,** This weekend will decide the future of our campaign. Right now, our grassroots movement is fighting for **ballot access** in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District. Over the next few days, the **Weld County and Douglas County assemblies will award 62% of the remaining delegates** in the entire district. That means something very simple. **If we win delegates this weekend, our campaign moves forward to the primary.
If we don’t, the fight for a real working-class voice in CD-4 could end before voters ever get the chance to weigh in.** So we are fighting as hard as we possibly can. Right now our team is: • Calling delegates from morning until night
• Sending thousands of texts across the district
• Driving hundreds of miles every day to meet people face-to-face
• Working 14–16 hour days organizing, planning, and mobilizing supporters Volunteers are stepping up.
People are opening their homes.
We are feeding staff and volunteers whenever we can and stretching every dollar as far as possible. This is the moment campaigns talk about when they say **everything is on the line.** But grassroots campaigns only survive moments like this **when people step up together.** If we secure delegates this weekend, the fight doesn’t end there. We must **hold those votes through the Congressional District Assembly on the 27th** , which means launching: • targeted digital ads
• direct mail to delegates
• organizing events across the district
• continued outreach from our volunteer team All of that requires resources. **We are NOT backed by PACs, special interests, or billionaire donors.** We are building this campaign the hard way - **one supporter at a time.** Because this campaign is not just about defeating Lauren Boebert. It is about putting **progressive ideas on the ballot** in Colorado’s 4th District: Affordable healthcare
Housing families can actually afford
Childcare working parents can rely on
Reinvestment in American manufacturing and workers
Bridging the rural-urban divide politicians exploit for power The people of this district deserve a real choice. And this weekend will decide whether they get one. If you can, please chip in today to help us push through this critical moment: Every dollar helps fuel the cars, print the materials, support volunteers, and reach the delegates who will decide this race. # [Trump touts historic Texas refinery opening](https://substack.com/redirect/d582a903-d130-4f7d-a4c9-f6c03e2991c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump celebrated the groundbreaking of a massive new refinery in Brownsville, Texas -- **[the first new major refinery built in the United States in nearly 50 years](https://substack.com/redirect/d582a903-d130-4f7d-a4c9-f6c03e2991c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** -- calling it a historic win for American energy independence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d582a903-d130-4f7d-a4c9-f6c03e2991c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **First new refinery in 50 years:** The facility in Brownsville will be the first major greenfield refinery constructed in the United States since the 1970s.
* **Huge investment claimed:** Trump described the project as a 300 billion dollar deal though the direct construction cost is estimated in the tens of billions.
* **Trump celebrates:** President Trump personally attended the groundbreaking and declared it a major step toward energy dominance.
* **Policy contrast:** Trump contrasted the project with previous administration policies that discouraged new fossil fuel infrastructure.

# **[How Everyday Investors Are Building Weekly Income Without Chasing Stocks](https://substack.com/redirect/f49f14da-0fd8-4637-ba21-28e154e8679d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

I remember watching investors in 2008 hold their breath...Waiting for their portfolios to recover. Some never did.
Today, markets still swing wildly. Headlines change by the hour. And most retirement accounts are built on one hope:
"Eventually, it'll go back up."
But what if retirement wasn't about waiting? What if it was about building income?
Over the past 20+ years, I've refined a structured approach designed to pursue **consistent weekly cash flow** using options -- without day trading, without gambling, and without needing a massive account.
Inside my Free Guidebook, you'll discover:
• Why most investors focus on growth -- and ignore income
• How weekly options can be used strategically instead of speculatively
• A repeatable framework built around rules, risk control, and structure
• How many everyday investors aim for $500-$5,000 per month in supplemental income
You can't control the market.
But you can control your strategy.

# [IEA proposes massive oil release](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce07e81-902f-4def-b3e0-7ca6900b5145?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The International Energy Agency is recommending an **[unprecedented 400 million barrel release](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce07e81-902f-4def-b3e0-7ca6900b5145?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from strategic reserves over 30 days to combat surging crude prices, with G7 ministers set to discuss joint action amid the Iran war.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce07e81-902f-4def-b3e0-7ca6900b5145?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Unprecedented release size:** IEA proposes releasing 400 million barrels over 30 days from strategic reserves to stabilize prices as Hormuz disruption continues.
* **G7 emergency meeting:** Finance ministers discussing coordinated SPR drawdown after oil surged above $100 per barrel for first time since 2022.
* **Iran war impact:** Strait of Hormuz closure has triggered the biggest supply disruption in history according to Rapidan Energy analysis.
* **[Crude prices swung wildly](https://substack.com/redirect/4485a109-47d5-4c0a-ab31-ba021f1fa390?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the IEA proposed the massive 400 million barrel emergency release from global reserves over 30 days to combat the supply shock from the Iran war.
* **Market volatility increases:** Brent crude dipped then rebounded as traders digest potential impact of proposed reserve release.

* * *
* * *
# [US targets Iranian mine ships](https://substack.com/redirect/9df46671-04ee-4a7b-b325-d329ffc7ac3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
US forces **[struck Iranian mine-laying vessels in the Strait of Hormuz](https://substack.com/redirect/9df46671-04ee-4a7b-b325-d329ffc7ac3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Wednesday, destroying two ships and preventing further mining attempts as the conflict escalates and oil prices remain above $100 per barrel.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9df46671-04ee-4a7b-b325-d329ffc7ac3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Direct naval engagement:** US destroyers engaged and sank two Iranian vessels attempting to lay mines in the critical waterway.
* **Hormuz remains closed:** Commercial tanker traffic still halted as Iran threatens complete blockade of the Strait.
* **Oil above $100:** Brent crude holding triple-digit levels despite Trump's comments about war nearing end.
* **Trump signals de-escalation:** President indicated conflict may soon conclude but Democrats call it a forever war.

* * *
* * *
# [JPMorgan limits private credit lending](https://substack.com/redirect/3139e9c6-cd16-48e9-a4b3-4a6e0a31fdb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan Chase is **[restricting new loans to the $1.8 trillion private credit sector](https://substack.com/redirect/3139e9c6-cd16-48e9-a4b3-4a6e0a31fdb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid growing concerns about liquidity risks and potential spillover from the industry's rapid expansion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3139e9c6-cd16-48e9-a4b3-4a6e0a31fdb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New lending restricted:** JPMorgan is limiting fresh exposure to private credit firms as sector faces increasing scrutiny.
* **Liquidity risks mount:** Bank is worried about opaque market's ability to handle withdrawals and economic stress.
* **Sector wide pressure:** Move follows similar actions by other major lenders amid $1.8 trillion industry growth.
* **Regulatory spotlight intensifies:** Treasury and Fed monitoring for potential systemic risks from private lending boom.

* * *
* * *
# [Oracle stock rockets on earnings beat](https://substack.com/redirect/503b87a1-9586-4236-8caf-dcc5e4e0355c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Oracle shares surged in after-hours trading after **[the company reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter earnings](https://substack.com/redirect/503b87a1-9586-4236-8caf-dcc5e4e0355c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and raised its 2027 revenue guidance, driven by booming cloud and AI business demand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/503b87a1-9586-4236-8caf-dcc5e4e0355c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Earnings beat expectations:** Oracle reported Q3 revenue and EPS above analyst consensus, sending shares sharply higher in extended trading.
* **2027 guidance raised:** Company increased full-year revenue outlook citing continued strength in cloud and AI segments.
* **AI demand drives growth:** Rapid adoption of Oracle's AI-powered cloud services fueled the positive results.
* **Stock reaction immediate:** Shares jumped over 10 percent in after-hours trading following the earnings release.

* * *
* * *
# [Meta announces it's own new AI chips](https://substack.com/redirect/2057a660-f9d9-4139-a19b-904f53e3a1c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta **[unveiled four new AI accelerator chips Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/2057a660-f9d9-4139-a19b-904f53e3a1c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to power its data centers and reduce dependence on Nvidia and AMD, escalating the competition in the custom silicon space for artificial intelligence hardware.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5dc4a711-dc9e-41b7-9154-9cf571cfcf64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New chip lineup:** Meta revealed four specialized AI accelerators designed for its massive data center infrastructure needs.
* **Reducing vendor dependence:** The move aims to lessen reliance on Nvidia and AMD for AI computing hardware.
* **Competitive stakes rise:** Announcement intensifies rivalry in the fast-growing custom AI chip market.
* **Data center focus:** Chips are optimized for Meta's specific AI training and inference requirements in social platforms.

* * *
* * *
# [Starbucks and it's CEO flee Washington as it passes a millionaire tax](https://substack.com/redirect/2d726d7e-ebdf-4e7b-a933-3d11b58e444a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Washington state Democrats approved a new 9.9 percent income tax on earnings above one million dollars, prompting Starbucks founder Howard Schultz to announce his **[family's departure from Seattle after four decades.](https://substack.com/redirect/2d726d7e-ebdf-4e7b-a933-3d11b58e444a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2d726d7e-ebdf-4e7b-a933-3d11b58e444a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tax rate details:** The new 9.9 percent state tax combines with the federal 37 percent rate to create a total burden exceeding 46 percent on high earners.
* **Schultz announcement:** Howard Schultz cited retirement and family reasons for moving to Miami Florida, ending 50 years in Seattle where he grew Starbucks from a small company.
* **Starbucks expansion:** The company is establishing a regional corporate office in Nashville Tennessee to support Southeast growth, highlighting the state's pro-business environment and lack of income tax.
* **Economic implications:** High tax burdens often lead to wealth migration as seen with Jeff Bezos' earlier departure, eroding the state's revenue base and incentivizing relocations to low-tax states.

* * *
* * *
# [California hospice fraud scandal explodes](https://substack.com/redirect/e363aad8-92d2-48fc-bb62-36d07ae46406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
California's hospice industry has seen **[fraud explode under Governor Newsom](https://substack.com/redirect/e363aad8-92d2-48fc-bb62-36d07ae46406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , with 105 million dollars in Medicare overbilling and more than 700 fraud warnings issued, as lax oversight allows widespread abuse.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e363aad8-92d2-48fc-bb62-36d07ae46406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive overbilling exposed:** California hospices submitted $105 million dollars in improper Medicare claims over recent years.
* **700 fraud warnings:** State regulators have issued over 700 fraud alerts for suspicious hospice activities.
* **Lax oversight blamed:** Weak regulation under Governor Newsom has allowed the problem to proliferate unchecked.
* **Widespread industry abuse:** Numerous hospices engaged in billing for ineligible patients and unnecessary services.

* * *
* * *
# [Nvidia invests $2 billion in AI startup](https://substack.com/redirect/e325f7e8-74c4-4ac3-a9c6-0a54a68e1375?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia is investing two billion dollars **[in a new AI startup accelerator program,](https://substack.com/redirect/e325f7e8-74c4-4ac3-a9c6-0a54a68e1375?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** aiming to fund and mentor emerging companies in artificial intelligence as the chip giant seeks to expand its ecosystem.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e325f7e8-74c4-4ac3-a9c6-0a54a68e1375?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive AI investment:** Nvidia committing two billion dollars to new accelerator for artificial intelligence startups.
* **Fund and mentor:** Program will provide capital and technical guidance to promising AI ventures.
* **Ecosystem expansion:** Move aims to grow Nvidia's influence in the broader AI technology landscape.
* **Startup boom targeted:** Investment comes amid surging interest in artificial intelligence companies worldwide.

* * *
* * *
# [Senate approves ChatGPT for staff](https://substack.com/redirect/0bfd3e56-5f72-4af4-be99-a1ff6a5cb78f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The U.S. Senate has **[approved ChatGPT for official staff use](https://substack.com/redirect/0bfd3e56-5f72-4af4-be99-a1ff6a5cb78f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while explicitly excluding Anthropic's Claude due to ongoing legal battles and security concerns, highlighting the selective approach to AI tools in government.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0bfd3e56-5f72-4af4-be99-a1ff6a5cb78f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **ChatGPT cleared:** Senate has given green light for staff to use OpenAI's ChatGPT for official work purposes.
* **Claude explicitly excluded:** Anthropic's model banned due to legal disputes and national security concerns.
* **Selective AI policy:** Decision reflects cautious approach to artificial intelligence in government operations.
* **Security concerns dominate:** Senate prioritizing tools with clear compliance and minimal risk profiles.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana

Cassidy Won't Commit on Dr. Casey Means

| | |

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
March 11, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**Trump-Endorsed Letlow Calls Out Cassidy for Stalling Surgeon General Nominee** _Cassidy Won’t Commit on Casey Means_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, today renewed her call for Senator Bill Cassidy to move Dr. Casey Means’ nomination for U.S. Surgeon General forward.
Despite President Trump making the confirmation a priority, Cassidy [told reporters yesterday](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=76fdd04906&e=95355a072c) he has "no updates" on the process or whether he will even vote to approve her.
As Chairman of the Senate Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions (HELP) Committee, Cassidy oversees whether Dr. Means’ nomination advances to the full Senate.
_“President Trump nominated Dr. Casey Means because America needs bold leadership to tackle the chronic disease crisis and restore trust in public health,”_**said Rep. Letlow.** _“If Senator Cassidy truly supports President Trump’s agenda, he should move this nomination forward and make his position clear. Instead, he is stalling.”_
**Rep. Letlow added:** _“This is a pattern Louisianans have seen before. Bill Cassidy voted to impeach President Trump. He did not vote for him in 2024. And now, as chairman with the power to move this nomination, he still will not say whether he supports the President’s pick. Louisiana deserves better.”_
For more information, visit [JuliaLetlow.com](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=9cae9f411c&e=95355a072c). ###
